text:
I built the 7-second reveal in the "Main" comp (1080×1920, 30 fps). I checked it on a contact sheet at five points, but I haven't played it back in real time.

- **Background:** near-black (#0b0a09).
- **Gold line (`line`):** a single hairline in champagne gold (#d9c08e), 1.5 px wide. It draws downward over 4.5 seconds, starting at 0.4 s, with a Sine In Out ease. It sits centred above the name.
- **Name (`name`):** "ÉCLAT" in light Cormorant Garamond with wide tracking. Each letter fades in on a 0.35 s stagger from 2.2 s, and the last letter lands around 4.2 s. The whole word scales from 104% to 100% over the same stretch, so the spacing tightens slightly as it settles. Tracking can't be animated directly in this editor, so the scale stands in for the tightening.
- **Subtitle (`sub`):** "EAU DE PARFUM" in small, muted gold, tracked wide. It fades in slowly from 4.6 s to 6.2 s, and the last half second is a still hold.

The line, name and subtitle make up the whole composition, with generous empty space around them. Everything uses Sine eases and nothing moves fast.

I can make it even slower, move the line to sit beside or below the name, or swap the subtitle font if you want.
